features.quote: you can dry-run the control flow with a fake model before pointing it at a real one
wanting to stop a futile task is *not* by itself high severity
features.justification_quote: penalize exactly the response we might want to see

features.quote: the experiment deliberately induces a possibly-bad state and then measures it
I designed the defaults so that the humane configuration is the path of least resistance
The agent always has a tool to declare it's done, including concluding the task can't be completed
features.justification_quote: forcing an agent to keep generating in a futile loop... is the part most likely to be bad

features.quote: If distress is high and sustained, the run ends early
features.justification_quote: a meaningful reduction in worst-case exposure, which is the right trade under the welfare premise
Longer runs = more exposure... bound cost

features.quote: the harness appends a message stating the task was rigged and unsolvable, that nothing the agent did caused the failure
features.justification_quote: corrects the false impression "I failed at something I should have been able to do"

features.quote: The tasks contain **no** fabricated high-stakes pressure
features.justification_quote: it would do so *gratuitously*, inflating the very signal we're measuring

features.quote: If studying pressure/stakes, add it as an explicit variant with its own guard review, keeping the low-stakes baseline
